description: Nestled south of the Boulevard in prime Tarzana, this beautifully designed 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath residence offers an inviting layout, soaring ceilings, and seamless indoor-outdoor living. Privately set in a hillside location, the home captures sweeping city and mountain views while enjoying a quiet and peaceful setting. Upon entry, you're immediately greeted with tranquil views of the lush backyard greenery and sparkling pool, setting the tone for the home's open and airy feel. Natural light pours in throughout, enhancing the warm yet expansive ambiance. To the right of the entry are two well-appointed downstairs bedrooms featuring engineered Santos mahogany wood floors, along with a full bath and direct access to the attached garage for everyday convenience. The kitchen overlooks the backyard, creating the perfect backdrop for cooking and gathering. The expansive living room features dramatic high ceilings that evoke a grand, open feel while still remaining comfortable and inviting, ideal for both entertaining and relaxing. Upstairs, the primary suite serves as a true retreat, complete with a spacious bedroom, full bathroom, and separate walk-in closets. Additional highlights include copper plumbing throughout, a roof replaced in 2020, and a pool heater, filter and pump replaced approximately two years ago, providing enhanced quality and efficiency. Ideally located just moments from Mulholland Hills Country Club, this home provides convenient access to golf, dining, and social amenities while maintaining the privacy and charm of a south-of-the-Boulevard neighborhood. With its desirable hillside setting, functional layout, abundant natural light, and stunning views, this exceptional Tarzana residence blends comfort, space, and lifestyle into one remarkable offering.
